ring.title: 👁️ **PUTRE RING HUNTER**
ring.description: 🔍 The ring hunter will pursue you to the end of time, accuse other users to avoid that ordeal.
ring.status_active: ✅ **ACTIVE HUNT** - Putre is looking for the ring
ring.investigation_instructions:
• GRRR! Use **Ring: Accuse** from the menu below stupid human
• Type: @username or ID of the suspect!
• Putre will generate threatening accusation to terrorize!
• Accusation will be published in channel for all to see!
ring.investigation_warning:
⚠️ CAREFUL IDIOT:
• You cannot accuse yourself, fool!
• You cannot accuse bots, they have no blood!
• Ring must be activated by orc chief first!
ring.inactive_instructions:
To activate ring functionality:
• An admin must go to **Ring Admin**
• Click on **Ring: On** to activate
• Configure the frequency for automatic investigations

Once activated, you can accuse users of carrying the One Ring!
ring.controls:
**Controls**
- Activate or deactivate ring
- Editable frequency box (sets base frequency and resets hot potato)
ring.admin_description: Configure sensitivity and frequency of the ring tracker

dropdown.ring_accuse_description: Accuse a user of carrying the One Ring
dropdown.ring_frequency_description: Configure the round frequency (affects hot potato)
